basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Controller of Examination (Namaste BHU Team) at Banaras Hindu University has invited online applications from Indian citizens for 2 Programmer posts (both UR) on a purely contractual basis up to 31 March 2027, which may be extended based on need. Pay is Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 65,000 consolidated, based on qualifications and experience. The essential qualification is B.Tech/MCA/MSc. or equivalent in IT/CS related areas with at least 60% marks. Apply only through http://www.bhu.ac.in/rac by 12.12.2026 (Advertisement No. Contractual 05/2026-27).

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: The posts sit under the Namaste BHU Team, for the Office of the Controller of Examination, Banaras Hindu University. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis. The notice describes the role as that of full stack developers.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 posts in total, both in the UR category.

rows.department: Office of the Controller of Examination (Namaste BHU Team)
rows.fixed_emoluments: Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 65,000 (consolidated) based on qualifications and experience

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. Eligibility and any other criteria are considered as on the last date of online submission, 12.12.2026. The notice also lists the following technical knowledge for the post: Programming in Python and JavaScript, Django, PHP Framework Basic software engineering: Git, command line, package management, reading documentation, exceptions/errors, logging, testing, development processes Databases: competency in SQL and database design Web/API basics: HTTP, JSON, REST-style APIs, client/server concepts, authentication at a basic conceptual level Ability to use AI tools intelligently Evidence of building things: should have built at least a web site, application, functions software system Good communication and reasoning skills The age limit printed in the notice is 30 years. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech/MCA/MSc. or equivalent in IT/CS related areas from a recognized University with at least 60% marks
rows.desirable: Proficiency in office productivity tools, including spreadsheet applications, for data analysis, data validation, processing and handling of large datasets

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fixed emoluments are Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 65,000 (consolidated), based on qualifications and experience. The engagement is purely on contract for a period up to 31st March, 2027, which may be extended based on need. The University reserves the right to withdraw any advertised post at any time without giving any reason, or to increase or decrease the number of posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHU Programmer
content_sections.text: Open the University website at http://www.bhu.ac.in/rac , the only route for applications. Submit the online application form on or before 12.12.2026. Retain a copy of the successfully submitted application form. If shortlisted, produce that copy along with supporting documents at the time of document verification. Candidates are advised to visit the University website regularly for updates on their eligibility status and shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an in-person written exam and Interview. They will be informed in advance by e-mail about the date of the Written Test and/or Interview, as applicable. The notice gives no date, pattern or marks for either stage. In any dispute or ambiguity in the selection process, the decision of the University is final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should bring original certificates/mark-sheets for verification at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Interview. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis.
